script.title: Endor Moon Patrol — Ewok Space Outpost
script.description: An Ewok-built forest moon scout craft launches beside a towering log village. A wedge nose, bubble canopy, blue-and-white hull and dish aerial give it the feel of a 1970s LEGO space set; elevated cabins, branch walks and a leafy crown bring the forest culture into the whole scene.
